Description: As a policyholder, I want to start a claim by selecting my policy so that I can report an incident.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an active policy, When I start a claim, Then a claim draft is created and assigned a reference.

Description: As a policyholder, I want the portal to validate my policy before submission so that I know whether it is eligible for a claim.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a valid active policy, When I submit its details, Then the portal confirms eligibility. Given an invalid or expired policy, When I submit, Then a validation message appears and the claim is not submitted.

Description: As a policyholder, I want to submit the incident date, type and description so that the insurer can assess my claim.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an eligible policy, When I submit complete incident details, Then the claim is registered. Given a missing incident date, When I submit, Then validation blocks submission and identifies the field.
